summary: Resource module tests rely on a builder-generated role, so after builder changes delete and regenerate rmb_tests/roles/my_role.
questions: How do I regenerate the test role after changing the resource module builder?

answer_card.title: Regenerate the test role
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
rm -rf rmb_tests/roles/my_role
ansible-playbook -e rm_dest=./rmb_tests/roles/my_role \
  -e structure=role \
  -e model=models/myos/interfaces/myos_interfaces.yml site.yml
```
Then update and rerun the tests as needed.
